prompt:

Asset type: C01-UNIT-WYVERN-RIDER, one production tactical-game IDLE sprite source. Genuine transparent RGBA.
Input images: image1 is the exact original rider and mount identity; image2 and image3 are approved chunky matte style and adult mounted proportions only. Recreate only image1 identity. Do not transfer stag/eagle anatomy, clothing, antlers, feathers or pointed elf ears.

Blue-gray broad scarf/cowl wrapped over shoulders. Worn dark brown leather armor with rounded shoulder plates, dark blue-gray underclothes, crossing brown straps, belt with small square brass buckle, brown leather bracers, brown trousers and tall strapped brown boots. Rider's near screen-left hand holds ONE short brown wooden spear nearly upright tilted slightly left, silver steel pointed head, with one small torn BLUE-GRAY pennant below the point bearing a tiny plain RED patch. Far/forward screen-right hand holds the tan rope reins. No helmet, shield, sword or bow. Mount anatomy must match original: a compact gray-olive reptile mount with FOUR distinct stout clawed legs, short forward-curving forelegs, amber eyes, broad angular lizard snout, small nostrils, closed mouth, swept-back gray head spines and small dorsal spines. Tan rope bridle around neck with an oval loop/knot at chest, simple rope reins.

Pose: same three-quarter facing screen-right view as image1. Grounded calm ready stance, near forefoot planted, opposite foreleg flexed slightly up, hindfeet support body. Rider sits upright naturally, looking screen-right, both hands in original roles. Tail curl complete. Three planted feet and one raised forefoot readable, leg gaps truly transparent. Do not float, fly, rear up or include any ground effect.

Style/medium: match images2/3 broad chunky matte tactical cartoon. Bold clean dark outer contour, large simplified adult face and hands, compact chunky forms, 2 or 3 flat cel-shaded value planes per form. Smooth matte surface. Coarse plates instead of tiny scales; broad cloth color areas instead of worn microtexture. No fine etching, scratches, stippling, grain, fuzzy hair, realistic texture, gradients, gleams or skinny anatomy. Adult capable cavalry identity, not a baby or cute pet.

Full figure including tail and spear within x300..1360 and y25..950. Saddle/body center around x820. Leave transparent room around all extremities, especially under claws. Keep whole native canvas for all later animation poses. No crop or zoom to fit subject. Genuine zero-alpha background and internal gaps; no painted checkerboard, magenta, opaque white/black, ground plane, cast shadow, haze, glow, halo, border, text, label, watermark, extra creature or object.
